name: Utakata no Uchronia
source:
The story takes place on a floating garden in the sky. Welcome to the renowned and prosperous utopia, the flying city of Itehari. Our protagonist is Hinagiku, a noble lady from a distinguished family who longs for the world beyond the floating city.

One day, Hinagiku, having just turned 18 years old, encounters an amnesiac man named Yashiro. Their fortuitous meeting becomes the catalyst that drags Hinagiku into a series of events involving the secrets and various truths hidden beneath the surface of the utopia.

Experience this tale as a noblewoman born and raised in Itehari. Meet a colorful cast of characters, build meaningful bonds, and eventually, dive headfirst into the sea of secrets lying far, far beneath Itehari's peaceful facade…

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/itehari/]Aksys Games[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在天空中的浮空花园。欢迎来到繁荣而闻名的乌托邦——浮空城伊特哈里。主角雏菊出身名门，是一位贵族千金，向往浮空城以外的世界。

某天，刚满18岁的雏菊遇到了一名失忆男子Yashiro。两人的命运般相遇成为一连串事件的开端，雏菊也因此被卷入调查乌托邦表面之下隐藏的秘密与真相。

扮演在伊特哈里出生长大的贵族女子，体验这个故事。结识形形色色的角色、建立深厚情谊，最终纵身跃入伊特哈里平静表象之下那片深不见底的秘密之海……[引自[url=https://www.aksysgames.com/itehari/]Aksys Games[/url]]
